payload.name: Firm
payload.description: This one’s not just committed — it’s already picking out furniture. Locked, loaded, and ready to ship. You can bet your forklift on it.

payload.name: Forecasted
payload.description: It says it’s coming... probably. Like a weather report for your warehouse — not guaranteed, but worth keeping an eye on.

payload.name: Planned
payload.description: It’s penciled in — there’s a date on the calendar, but don’t carve it in stone just yet. Think of it as a strong ‘maybe’ with a time attached.
